maps.name: Alpine Bowl
maps.description: An open mountain. Four faces around one valley, a cirque, a gully, cliffs, a frozen tarn and a park, all draining to the village.

maps.name: First Tracks
maps.description: A wide, forgiving groomer with soft rollers and a proper banked turn. Learn to link turns.

maps.name: Glade Run
maps.description: A winding gully through the trees with banked turns, a gladed pitch and a kicker to finish.

maps.name: Ridge Line
maps.description: Steep upper face, a cliff band onto a steep landing, a mogul field, then a rock chute to the finish.

maps.name: Cornice
maps.description: A long run-in to one very big jump, then a fast tail with two smaller hits.

maps.name: Spine Line
maps.description: A knife-edge spine with both sides falling away, into a tight chute and a bowl.

maps.name: Couloir
maps.description: A rock-walled chute that never opens up, with an ice band halfway and a sudden apron at the bottom.
